name: REPLACED_AT_SEED_TIME
description: Harness-seeded single guest-static-IP V2 template. One standalone client VM with a single NIC bound by networkId to a dedicated Internal lab switch and holding a static IP (10.80.0.20/24), so the plan requires guest work - in-guest static-IP configuration - and can only start once the local bootstrap credential slot is filled. The VM references the REAL prepared Windows Server base image (guest-configurable via its bootstrap profile). This is the lean, non-DC, non-router proof that a simple static IP lands on the correct adapter. Safe to delete.
